claims.claim: PromptPack schema requires id, name, version, template_engine, prompts; optional $schema, description, fragments, tools, metadata, compilation, evals, workflow, agents, skills, compositions, requires
embedded PromptPack schema is version 1.9.0 (identical to promptpack-spec schema)
validate accepts a pack without compilation and prints a warning

pack id ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$, version semver with optional v, template_engine version+syntax; prompt requires id,name,version,system_template, id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$; tool requires name,description
each prompt gets the default template/provider/validator pipeline
packc compile builds tools from kind: Tool files; a prompt's tools list names entries in it

workflow requires version, entry, states; state fields on_event, persistence, orchestration internal|external|hybrid|composition, control user|agent, terminal, max_visits, on_max_visits, skills, artifacts, composition; engine optional
workflow warnings: PascalCase, cycles, terminal with on_event, v2 dead-end; version 1|2

packc reads each fragment file a prompt config references, relative to that prompt config's directory, and stores the file's content in fragments; a fragment chosen by a template variable is written as {{name}}
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description, $schema latest URL, compilation block with schema v1
compile-prompt: version is spec.version unless --pack-version; $schema set; compilation.schema v1
invalid --id rejected before compile with [pack_id] error
workflow control: spec default is user; PromptKit runtime treats absent control as the agent keeping the turn
